Risk_Title: Premature Execution of Calibration Before Authorization
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Protocol_Closure: Strict stop condition enforced. No calibration runs or parameter updates executed in this task. Await explicit reviewer sign-off.
Strict sequential hierarchy: Step 1 calibrates C_bed only; Step 2 freezes C_bed*; Step 3 evaluates C_schoof; theta_buttress held strictly fixed.
Rigorous split: Calibration flowlines (Ryder, Crane) strictly segregated from validation flowlines (Millett, Flask, Drygalski, Mass Budget).
Flanders Bay strictly excluded from calibration and validation target sets at 500 m grid resolution. Zero parameter tuning against 210 m/yr.
Mandatory stop conditions defined: optimization immediately aborts if C_bed hits 1e5 or 1e8, or if Hessian condition number exceeds 100.
